g.text: +run(work : Supplier<T>, onDone : Consumer<T>, onError : Consumer<Throwable>) : void
Agent calls take seconds, so CoachController
runs them through FxTaskRunner on a background
thread. Results and events reach the panels on
the JavaFX Application Thread via Platform.runLater,
+loadRange(e1rm : double, reps : int, rpe : double, week : int) : Range
The rest of the system depends only on the
LLMClient and Tool interfaces, so the
+complete(msgs : List<Message>, tools : List<ToolSchema>, system : String) : LLMResponse
+validateBlock(b : TrainingBlock, ctx : AgentContext, s : ProgressionStrategy) : ValidationReport
+validateMeal(m : MealSuggestion, d : DietaryConstraints, remaining : MacroTotals) : ValidationReport
+candidates(pattern : String, muscles : Set<String>, eq : Set<Equipment>) : List<Exercise>
